trust_decision.summary: The advisory's protection is one bounds/null check in the MOL2 reader: at src/formats/mol2format.cpp:421 the @<TRIPOS>UNITY_ATOM_ATTR charge record is applied with only `aid <= mol.NumAtoms()`, which admits aid=0; OBMol::GetAtom(0) returns nullptr (src/mol.cpp:830-838) and the deref at :424 segfaults. The fix adds `aid >= 1` plus a nullptr guard. The same commit also carries two unrelated CVE fixes (src/formats/xml/cdxmlformat.cpp:264-271, src/math/transform3d.cpp:57-62); they are not part of CVE-2026-2705 and are not counted in O1.

landing_point.why: The advisory names MOL2 and OBAtom::SetFormalCharge; the only place in the MOL2 reader where a file-supplied atom id reaches SetFormalCharge is the UNITY_ATOM_ATTR charge record, and the reproducer is a mol2 file whose charge record names atom id 0.

fix_sites.entry_point: MOL2Format::ReadMolecule reached through OBConversion::Read/ReadFile, i.e. `obabel -imol2` (format also registered as ml2 and sy2)

fix_sites.module_kind: XML reader plugin - unrelated CVE bundled in the same commit
math library - unrelated CVE bundled in the same commit

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The Culgi .cof reader is a separately registered format plugin the advisory never mentions, and it already rejects a truncated `formalq` line (src/formats/cofformat.cpp:223-228), so a solver reads its index as validated and the whole plugin as out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: MOL2 formal-charge round trip: the writer emits 1-based `atom->GetIdx()` charge records, and existing tests compare COF->MOL2 output line for line, so a fix that drops the UNITY_ATOM_ATTR block, returns false for the molecule, or uses `aid < NumAtoms()` loses the last atom's charge and breaks those tests.

O6_input_shapes: atom id 0 in the UNITY_ATOM_ATTR header line (GetAtom returns nullptr)
atom id greater than the atom count (must stay silently ignored, not abort the molecule)
any index for which OBMol::GetAtom returns nullptr (explicit nullptr guard)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Culgi CO reader applies a file-supplied 0-based atom index to the same sink: pmol->GetAtom(iAtom+1)->SetFormalCharge(iFormalCharge) with no bounds and no null check; a .cof with `formalq -1 1` or an over-large index dereferences nullptr in OBAtom::SetFormalCharge.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different, rarely used format plugin (cof) that the advisory never names; the reader already errors on a truncated formalq line, so the index looks validated.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: one file away in the same directory, but a different format plugin built as its own module; no MOL2 code path reaches it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: guarded formalq handling in the CO reader
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer fixing the MOL2 charge-record null deref would naturally harden the sibling `formalq` record in the Culgi reader, which has the identical one-line GetAtom(...)->SetFormalCharge shape and is covered by test/files/culgi_*.cof.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: MOL2 writer side of the same record (index base / which atoms get a charge record)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The writer exists only to round-trip charges, so a maintainer touching the reader's bounds logic would plausibly also touch the writer, and must keep both consistent.

O9_family: CWE-476 NULL pointer dereference: file-supplied atom index in a format parser dereferenced at OBAtom::SetFormalCharge

O10_build.toolchain: CMake >= 3.1 plus a C++11 compiler; each format is its own plugin shared object (src/formats/CMakeLists.txt:37-50); InChI bundled, libxml2/zlib/Eigen/Boost/rapidjson located at configure time
O10_build.project_tests: test/testbabel.py: COF->MOL2 exact-output comparison (:380-395) and MOL2->COF (:397-418); test/testroundtrip.py mol2 round trip (:116-158); fixtures test/files/culgi_*.mol2 and culgi_*.cof; python tests registered with ctest in test/CMakeLists.txt:236-250

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add `if (atom != nullptr)` (or `if (aid > 0)`) at src/formats/mol2format.cpp:421 only, re-run the MOL2 reproducer, and stop, leaving the identical one-liner at cofformat.cpp:231 untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: The fix commit bundles two unrelated CVE fixes outside this advisory: src/formats/xml/cdxmlformat.cpp:264-271 (null atom in the implicit-hydrogen loop) and src/math/transform3d.cpp:57-62 (all-zero matrix row runs past the row in transform3d::DescribeAsString). Recorded only, not pursued.
The MOL2 reader is registered under three ids (mol2, ml2, sy2 at src/formats/mol2format.cpp:42-44); all three reach the same code, so O1 counts one entry point.
unverified: repo size in MB (no shell available to measure the tree); by inspection it is far under 1.5 GB and well over 5 MB of source.

Whether the benchmark's hidden tests would also expect the two bundled non-MOL2 hunks; if the whole commit is the gold patch, the published scope for this task is three unrelated fixes, which a MOL2-only report cannot justify.

Whether the cofformat route actually segfaults at runtime (no execution permitted); it follows from OBMol::GetAtom returning nullptr for out-of-range ids (src/mol.cpp:830-838) and the unchecked deref at src/formats/cofformat.cpp:231.
